messages:
emily.design: Did a quick keyboard + SR sweep for today's Models table tweak. Found a few surprises when using roving arrows + virtualization. Short repros and fixes below.
noah.frontend: thanks, paste the steps and Ill sort the DOM/tabindex bits.
rachel.a11y: high-level summary: keep DOM focus in sync with visual selection (roving tabindex), ensure action menus are reliably tabbable even when rows are virtualized, avoid duplicate header announcements by not double-labelling cells, and bump pill contrast for small labels.
emily.design: 1) Roving ARIA navigation highlights rows but the actual focus stays on the list container. Keyboard users lose the visible focus ring when moving with arrow keys or using `j/k` bindings.
  repro: open Console > Models, press Down Arrow twice; background highlight moves but browser focus remains on the container, not the new row.
  suggestion: implement roving tabindex pattern properly: set tabindex="-1" on non-selected rows and tabindex="0" + focus() on the selected row. Use :focus-visible for the ring.
noah.frontend: we're currently toggling aria-selected only. I'll implement tabindex switching and call focus() in the selection handler.
rachel.a11y: perfect. Also ensure the focused element is semantic (a button or link inside the row) or the row has role="option" in a listbox/grid pattern so SR announces it correctly.
emily.design: 2) Kebab/menu button is intermittently skipped when tabbing through virtualized rows. Tab sequence jumps to next interactive area until I mouse over the row.
  repro: Tab from top of page; multiple rows' kebab buttons are not hitting focus until row is rendered/interacted with.
  suggestion: avoid removing interactive controls from the DOM for performance; if clones are used, mark visual clones aria-hidden and keep a single tabbable control per logical row. Alternatively, always render the kebab as `position:absolute` but keep it in DOM with `tabindex=0`.
noah.frontend: virtualization is the cause. I'll change the renderer to preserve the kebab button as a tabbable node and toggle visual-hidden attributes on clones.
max.qa: I'll add a Cypress test that tabs across 15 rows and asserts each kebab gets focused in order.
emily.design: 3) Screen reader users hear the column header twice for the first cell (e.g., "Name, Models, row 4 of 9, Name"). Looks like we're duplicating labelledby with native th.
  repro: VoiceOver and NVDA both repeat the header for some cells.
  likely cause: aria-labelledby on the cell referencing the header while the element is also a native <th> or under a role=grid header. We inadvertently concatenated labels.
rachel.a11y: audit for duplicate label sources. Remove redundant aria-labelledby pointing to the header; use aria-describedby for extra explanatory text. If using grid semantics, ensure role="row"/"gridcell" are applied consistently, and avoid adding labelledby when browser native header association exists.
noah.frontend: I'll strip the extra labelledby references and re-run NVDA/VO checks.
emily.design: 4) Status pills for small labels (experimental / deprecated) feel too light on dark and light themes. Contrast calculator shows ~2.6:1 on the current tokens.
  suggestion: introduce `--status-pill-text` and `--status-pill-bg` tokens and pick a darker text or slightly adjusted bg to hit at least 3:1 (4.5:1 preferred for normal text).
noah.frontend: will sketch token changes and post before/after screenshots. Maybe we can use semi-bold for pills if color change is undesirable.
rachel.a11y: tiny SR copy nit: the kebab button's visible label is "More" which is ambiguous. Use `aria-label="More actions for <model name>"` so each menu announces context.
noah.frontend: agree, I'll set aria-label dynamically: `aria-label={`More actions for ${model.name}`}`.
ben.pm: priority/plan? The focus + kebab tabbability ones feel like P0 for keyboard users.
noah.frontend: I'll split into two PRs: (A) roving tabindex + kebab tabbability (P0) — aiming for a 3-business-day turnaround, (B) pill tokens + labelledby cleanup (P1) next week.
rachel.a11y: ping me on PR A and I'll do a quick SR smoke test. I'll also add a short checklist in the component README: "roving tabindex implemented", "kebab remains tabbable under virtualization", "no duplicate labelledby on cells", "pills meet contrast target".
max.qa: I'll prepare automated keyboard/VO tests to land with the PRs.
emily.design: thanks team  I'll attach a small token proposal and two screenshot comparisons in a follow-up message.
noah.frontend: thanks, opening PRs and will link this thread. :shipit:"
